comment: Not a good professor. Frequently agitated and known to criticize students. Grade on the "subjectivity scale" -- a.k.a., docks you a letter grade if she doesn't like you.

Cold calls. Also does 'lightning round' where she randomly calls people. Exam is 90% of grade, closed notes. A few writing problems during the semester. Pretty clear, goes on tangents. Funny. Helpful outside of class. Does triathlons I think which is cool. Property is not her main focus in academia though.
